title: Claude History MCP
blurb: An MCP server that indexes every past conversation transcript and gives Claude a searchable long-term memory with 6 auto-usable tools.
body:
An MCP server that indexes all your past conversation transcripts and provides 6 tools Claude can use automatically — like giving your AI pair-programmer a brain that persists between sessions.

What it does

  • Hybrid search engine: BM25 + TF-IDF + Reciprocal Rank Fusion across all conversations
  • Knowledge extraction: auto-pulls decisions, solutions and error→fix patterns from each session
  • Session-start hook: auto-injects relevant project context on a new session
  • Filter syntax, e.g. docker error project:myapp after:7d
  • Indexes ~170 sessions in ~9s · searches under 200ms

Learnings system

Clusters similar solutions/error-fixes using Jaccard similarity on stemmed words, scores them by frequency and cross-project reach, then promotes high-scoring clusters into "learnings" that surface automatically — written to MEMORY.md with sentinel markers so your own notes stay untouched.

SOURCE · "Claude Code doesn't remember what it learned today" LinkedIn post.
